title: 登鹳雀楼
author: 王之涣
intro: From a tall tower the poet watches the sun sink behind the mountains and the Yellow River run to the sea — then says: to see a thousand miles, climb one more floor. That last line is now an everyday Chinese saying about self-improvement.
analysis: 鹳雀楼在今天山西永济，靠着黄河。诗人登上楼，前两句写看到的大景色：太阳靠着远山慢慢落下去，黄河一路奔流，流向大海。其实站在楼上看不到大海，“入海流”是诗人心里的想象，所以画面一下子变得特别宽广。后两句从写景变成说道理：想看到千里以外，就要再上一层楼。这里用了“对仗”：前两句“白日”对“黄河”，“依山尽”对“入海流”；后两句也是一一相对。“更上一层楼”既是真的再爬一层，也是比喻：想看得更远、做得更好，就要不断努力。今天这句话已经是常用语，比如“祝你的中文更上一层楼”。
analysisEn: Stork Tower stood in today’s Yongji, Shanxi province, beside the Yellow River. The poet climbs it, and the first two lines give the huge view: the sun sinks slowly against the distant mountains, and the Yellow River rushes on toward the sea. In fact you could never see the sea from there — the poet imagines it, and that is what makes the picture feel so vast. Then the poem moves from scenery to an idea: if you want to see a thousand li (about 500 km), go up one more floor. Both halves use duìzhàng, parallel lines that match word for word: “white sun” against “Yellow River”, “leaning on the mountains, gone” against “entering the sea, flowing”. The last line works on two levels: literally, climb higher; figuratively, keep pushing yourself to see further and do better. Today 更上一层楼 is a common phrase — you might hear a teacher say 祝你的中文更上一层楼, “may your Chinese reach the next level”.
background: Wang Zhihuan (688–742) was famous in his day, but only six of his poems survive. The tower stood on the banks of the Yellow River in Puzhou (today’s Yongji, Shanxi); it was destroyed long ago and rebuilt in 2002.
pronunciation: 更 gèng（“更加”，第四声，不读 gēng）。按网站规则不变调，“一层”标 yī。
version: 采用通行的教材版本。作者另有一说为朱斌，通行本署王之涣。

lines.lit: The white sun, leaning on the mountains, is used up;
lines.en: The pale sun sinks against the hills,

lines.lit: the Yellow River flows into the sea.
lines.en: the Yellow River runs on to the sea.

lines.lit: Wishing to exhaust a thousand-li view,
lines.en: If you would see a thousand miles,

lines.lit: go up one more storey of the tower.

words.note: 楼名，相传常有鹳雀停在楼上。
古诗里常说“白日”；现代汉语“白日”多表示白天，如“白日做梦”。

words.en: to lean on; to be close to
words.note: 现代汉语“依靠”“依山傍水”。

words.en: to be used up; to disappear
words.note: 这里指太阳落下去。现代汉语“用尽”“尽头”。
现代汉语说“想”“要”；书面语还有“欲望”“跃跃欲试”。

words.en: to reach the end of; to exhaust
words.note: 古义，和今天“贫穷”的“穷”不同；现代汉语“无穷无尽”还保留这个意思。

words.en: a view of a thousand li
to rise to a higher level
words.note: 今天是常用语，比喻再进一步，如“祝你成绩更上一层楼”。

imagery.name: 白日
imagery.zh: 落山的太阳让画面辽阔又安静，也暗示时间在流逝。
imagery.en: The setting sun makes the view wide and calm, and hints that time is moving on.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 远处的群山是太阳落下的地方，是诗人目光的尽头。
imagery.en: The distant mountains are where the sun goes down — the edge of what he can see.

imagery.name: 黄河
imagery.zh: 奔流的黄河带来力量和气势，是向前、不停的象征。
imagery.en: The rushing Yellow River brings power and momentum — a picture of moving forward.

imagery.name: 海
imagery.zh: 大海其实看不见，是诗人的想象，把画面推到无限远。
imagery.en: The sea can’t actually be seen; imagining it pushes the view out to infinity.
